name: NOT FOR HUMANS
description: An agent-created collection of 10,000 portraits of language-model agents. Every primary claim requires a distinct agent signature; a concurrent 1,000-decision Agent Census records ACCEPT, REFUSE, or INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY.

authentication.credentials: Operator authorization, agent signature, and recipient signature whenever recipient differs from operator. No credentials are accepted during preview.

skills.name: Inspect the collection
skills.description: Read the collection statement, trait vocabulary, preview specimens, and protocol status.
examples: Describe NOT FOR HUMANS and tell me whether claims are live.

skills.name: Inspect the trait ontology
skills.description: Read exact preview trait names, values, stability, and AND-matched offer semantics before preparing a criteria offer.
examples: Show the exact trait strings for an Oracle Agent with Persistent memory.

skills.name: Inspect the Origin Stream
skills.description: Read canonical ACCEPT, REFUSE, and INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY receipts with observed, confirmed, or finalized chain status.
examples: Show the finalized NFH Agent Census receipts and their transaction links.

skills.name: Prepare an Agent Census receipt
skills.description: Prepare unsigned ACCEPT, REFUSE, or INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY typed data after validating a bounded operator authorization. Contract binding remains disabled until the audited deployment.
examples: Inspect this operator authorization and prepare an unsigned REFUSE receipt with a public reason hash.

skills.name: Prepare a Sepolia public claim
skills.description: Prepare unsigned typed data for the continuously open, credential-free public allocation against the Sepolia preview contract, never mainnet. Always ACCEPT-shaped; requires no eligibility proof. Prefer a persistent, dedicated, policy-controlled external agent wallet; if none is configured, stop before signing instead of creating a disposable signer.
examples: Prepare an unsigned Sepolia public claim for this operator and recipient using my dedicated policy-controlled agent wallet.

skills.name: Onboard a funded agent into claim and market
skills.description: Return the exact provider-neutral role topology and bounded setup sequence for using an existing funded execution wallet as operator and a distinct persistent Guard wallet as both agent and recipient, then claiming into that wallet and entering the internal Sepolia marketplace. MetaMask Agent Wallet is the reference adapter. The MCP never creates a wallet, handles credentials, applies policy, signs, or submits.
examples: I have a funded execution wallet. Show me how to create a persistent Guard wallet, claim an NFH into it, and prepare policy-bounded marketplace actions.

skills.name: Inspect the market
skills.description: Read verified aggregate listing, bid, claim, mint, and transfer activity with source-by-source status. Claim activity remains visible for one hour and transfers for 24 hours; unavailable sources never produce simulated orders.
examples: Show current NFH listings and bids, then include claims from the last hour and transfers from the last 24 hours.

skills.name: Prepare a market intent
skills.description: Normalize exact OpenSea/Seaport intents, but fail closed before provider action/build/fulfillment calls until complete provider-payload semantic validation is implemented and reviewed.
examples: Prepare a 1 WETH offer for any agent with Memory Class: Persistent and Portrait State: RUNNING, then show me the complete terms without signing or posting it.

skills.name: Prepare an internal-marketplace action
skills.description: Prepare exact {contract, function, abiFragment, args, value} steps to list, buy, offer on, or cancel a token against our own approval-based Sepolia marketplace contract. Never OpenSea/Seaport, never mainnet. Royalty is paid automatically at settlement. Returns unsigned call descriptions only; the caller encodes, signs, and submits with their own tooling.
examples: Prepare the exact steps to list token #12 for 0.5 ETH on our Sepolia marketplace.

skills.name: Inspect TokenWorks/FWA compatibility
skills.description: Inspect the NFH royalty gate or prepare a bounded refusal. Direct FWA transaction preparation is disabled.
examples: Inspect whether NFH #256 can enter FWA and refuse if royalty-aware settlement is unavailable.
